page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.u2i family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz, providing 32 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) and 128.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It also lacks dedicated graphics processing units (GPUs), making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a standard general-purpose resource. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention. This resource density is appropriate for workloads such as medium-sized databases, enterprise application hosting, web serving, and general-purpose business applications that require a balance of compute and memory without specialized hardware acceleration.
